comments.author: @c.d.dailey8013
comments.text:
I recently learned about the existence of the song. I liked the song. It was catchy. Then last night I learned what the song actually means. Oh no! That is horrific. It really sounds like torturing a poor little bird. I went further and found it was about plucking dead little birds before cooking them. 

I found other songs like that. Another one I recently learned is "Oh My Dear Augustine". It sounds like a really nice song, a catchy song. Then I learned it was about some poor dude that accidentally got dumped in a mas grave with plagued corpses. That is so disgusting. That is screwed up. I first heard the Alluete song and the Augustine song from The Chipmunks. Those chipmunks really sugarcoated the songs to make them family friendly.

Ooh! There is this other song I learned about a long time ago called "Oranges and Lemons". I like the song. It is a beautiful song. Now I think of the lyrics. The title is about citris fruit. Okay. There is a lot about individual churches and how their bells are ringing. Okay. Church bells can sound beautiful. There is something about owing money. Okay. Debt is bad but it isn't one of the worst things. I hear some versions with added lyrics about lighting candles by the bed and about head chopping. What???!! Last night, I looked up this song on Google and found there is something really disturbing about this beautiful song. This song is actually about a notorious prison. It may be in London. The prison is bad due to nasty and cruel living conditions. Debtors were imprisoned there. Yikes!! That is really screwed up. The worst prisoners, like murderers, get executed. That is what the head chopping comes from. Major yikes.

There are at least a few dark folk songs. This is disturbing.
